items.title: Victor Rendon interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I’ve been in contact with Chembo, of course you met Chembo. I’ve spoken to Cascadú a few times. I have a weekly Zoom meeting — I don’t hold it but my bass player sort of has like a conference Zoom meeting at 8:00 every Wednesday evening, so several Bronx members are involved in that.

ctx.x: Are you in touch with your band members in your Bronx-Conexion Orchestra?

I’ve been in contact with Chembo, of course you met Chembo. I’ve spoken to Cascadú a few times. I have a weekly Zoom meeting — I don’t hold it but my bass player sort of has like a conference Zoom meeting at 8:00 every Wednesday evening, so several Bronx members are involved in that. So that’s our way of keeping in contact with each other. But some of the band members I haven’t called but I will soon because the Nuyorican is thinking of opening as soon as we can. They’re thinking about August, September. But then…
Being in the greater New York City area, you’ve been a hot spot. And up here we’re now entering Phase 3. So more things are opening but still large gatherings with music is not on the list yet.
